name: Bia hoi
summary: Bia hơi is Hanoi’s fresh draft beer, unpasteurized and drunk soon after it is made, as light as water.
origin: Hanoi, where sidewalk beer is a local habit.
howToEat: Drink it fresh: it is unpasteurized and meant to be drunk soon after it is brewed.
Sit on a stool at the beer corner.
where: Tạ Hiện and Lương Ngọc Quyến.
seoTitle: Bia hoi — Hanoi fresh draft beer
seoDescription: Bia hơi in Hanoi is fresh draft beer, unpasteurized and drunk soon after it is made, on the stools at Tạ Hiện and Lương Ngọc Quyến.
